items.name: canvas-globe
items.title: CanvasGlobe
items.description: A responsive, interactive Canvas 2D globe for React with markers, animated routes, themes, keyboard controls, and no WebGL requirement.
items.author: Harsh Jhunjhunuwala
items.docs: Start a 30-day trial at https://canvasglobe.swiftools.com/trial or purchase a production license at https://canvasglobe.swiftools.com/pricing, then activate before building: https://canvasglobe.swiftools.com/activate.
